name: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith
passives: Solar Law: coordinated Titans gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.
lore: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith is a colossal Aten Ra Titan shaped by sacred order channels solar power into civilization. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber Radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms. The silhouette must be colossal, non-human, readable on mobile, and unmistakably Aten Ra.
developmentStatus: Playable data scaffold complete; artwork pending.
